body.en:
Question B-007-003-006.

Why the correct answer is right: With the layer height held the same, a steeper upward path returns closer to the transmitter. The skip distance decreases for geometric reasons.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "It decreases, due to the decrease in critical frequency": It decreases, due to the decrease in critical frequency gives the right direction for the wrong reason; critical frequency is not what changed in this geometry question.
- sourceIndex 2: "It increases, due to the geometry of the signal path": It increases, due to the geometry of the signal path reverses the geometry; higher angle makes the first return closer.
- sourceIndex 3: "It increases, due to the increase in critical frequency": It increases, due to the increase in critical frequency changes both direction and cause incorrectly.
